newsitem.title: THAILAND: Sahaviriya says 1996 sales at 9.5 bln bht.
newsitem.headline: Sahaviriya says 1996 sales at 9.5 bln bht.

text.p: Thailand's Sahaviriya Steel Industries Plc (SSI) said on Tuesday its 1996 sales of hot-rolled steel amounted to 9.52 billion baht ($380.8 million), lower than its target of 15 billion baht.
SSI managing director Adisak Lowjun told a news conference poor sales were due to a slowdown in the economy and dumping by countries like Russia and the Ukraine.
He said the company sold 1.16 million tonnes of steel in 1996, of which 997,000 tonnes was sold domestically. The remainder was exported.
Sahaviriya Steel imported about 1.228 million tonnes of steel slab, the raw material for hot-rolled steel, at an average cost of $237 a tonne in 1996.
Adisak declined to reveal 1996 earnings, but the company reported a loss of 1.64 billion baht during the first nine months of the year.
